```sql
WITH lvl1 AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           sum(ol.quantity)         AS q,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY pv.product_id, o.id, pv.id
),
tot AS (
    SELECT product_id, sum(q)::bigint AS quantity, sum(r) AS revenue_cents
      FROM lvl1 GROUP BY product_id
),
po AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT product_id, order_id FROM lvl1 GROUP BY 1, 2) s
     GROUP BY product_id
),
pvc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT product_id, variant_id FROM lvl1 GROUP BY 1, 2) s
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       po.order_count,
       t.quantity,
       t.revenue_cents,
       pvc.variant_count
  FROM tot t
  JOIN po  ON po.product_id  = t.product_id
  JOIN pvc ON pvc.product_id = t.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = t.product_id
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure externe sort op (p.id, o.id) voor de `count(DISTINCT ...)` vervalt. In plaats daarvan wordt eerst per (product, order, variant) geaggregeerd met hash-aggregaties, en worden de distinct-tellingen afgeleid uit deze veel kleinere tussenset. Met de cast naar bigint blijven de resultaattypen gelijk aan het origineel, en de producten worden pas na de aggregatie gejoind.
